extName.message: Geo Tier Builder — Country Tiers & GEO Lists

extDescription.message: Build tiered country lists and GEO allow/block segments for ad targeting, TDS rules, Cloudflare WAF, and traffic management.

regexOutputLabel.message: Regex for the TDS path field

regexEmptyWarning.message: Empty pattern — leaving the TDS path field blank matches every request.

regexCatchAllWarning.message: Catch-all matches every request. This rule MUST have the lowest priority (rules evaluate priority DESC, first match wins).

regexSlugsPlaceholder.message:
One slug per line or comma-separated, e.g.
promo
signup
landing

regexTesterPlaceholder.message:
Paste pathnames or full URLs, one per line:
/promo
https://go.example.com/promo/abc?utm=1

regexHint.message: TDS runs new RegExp(path).test(url.pathname) — substring match on the pathname only (no query/host). Rules evaluate by priority DESC; the first match wins.

serpCountrySearch.message: Search country — name, code, or alias

serpHint.message: Opens google.com with gl / hl / uule set for the chosen country — the SERP renders as seen from that geo. An approximation: your real IP still affects the local pack and ads.

welTagline.message: Country tiers & GEO lists for traffic management

welPinHint.message: Tip: pin Geo Tier Builder to the toolbar (puzzle menu → pin icon) so the panel is always one click away.

welHeroText.message: Pick countries by region, tier, or meta-group and export a copy-paste-ready list for your TDS, Cloudflare, or server config — fully offline.

welStep1Text.message: Search 249 countries, filter by region, tier (T1/T2/T3), or meta-groups like EU, G20, BRICS.

welStep2Text.message: 10 export formats: 301.st TDS CSV, Cloudflare WAF & Workers, nginx map, JSON, and more.

welStep3Text.message: Drop the output into TDS geo fields, WAF expressions, or server configs. Done.

welTabList.message: the country picker — search, filters, allow/block mode, favorites

welTabRegex.message: path-regex helper for 301.st TDS rules, with a live tester

welTabSerp.message: preview Google results as seen from any country and language

welTabImport.message: paste any messy country list — it normalizes to ISO2 automatically

welPrivacyText.message: Zero telemetry, zero network requests by default — everything runs offline with only storage and side-panel permissions. The one exception: the optional publisher news below, off until you turn it on.

welNews.message: Publisher news — a notification when 301.sh publishes a post (checked every 6 hours, nothing about you is sent). Off until you click the bell.

newsTitleOn.message: Publisher news — on: 301.sh is checked every 6 hours, new posts arrive as notifications. Click to turn off.

newsTitleOff.message: Publisher news — off. Click to get a notification when 301.sh publishes a post.

importPlaceholder.message: Paste country codes, names, or mixed list…

settingsCustomTiersDesc.message: Override default tier assignments for specific countries

emptyState.message: No countries match the current filters
